title: The morning sheet
blurb: Every location on one page before opening, built from the point of sale and from the supplier invoices it cannot see.
replaces: Opening three portals and rebuilding yesterday by hand
point: A 2% price drift nobody caught, on $70k of monthly purchasing, is roughly $1,400 a month

title: Avo
blurb: You say it once. It reaches the website, Instagram and Google in three different registers, and the agent checks the page before it tells you it is done.
replaces: Writing one announcement four times, then not being sure the fourth went out
point: Every channel is verified against the live page, so the one that silently did not publish is caught the same morning

title: The invoice reader
blurb: Drop in one supplier invoice, PDF or photo. Your own lines come back with a price per kilogram beside each, and anything it cannot price honestly is set aside with the reason. Nothing is kept.
replaces: A calculator, the invoice, and guessing what is inside a 4/5 LB case
time: about 10 minutes per invoice, done properly
point: Two cases at the same price can hide a 20% difference per kilogram, and only the division shows it
